image_description: A reddish-brown foal (sorrel) running in a grassy field with a wooden fence in the background. The horse has white markings on its lower legs (socks/stockings). The image exhibits severe AI-generation artifacts, particularly in the limbs which appear melted, elongated, and structurally impossible.

The neck lacks defined musculature and appears to blend into the shoulder without clear anatomical separation.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The front legs have completely lost anatomical structure, appearing as melted white tubes extending from the shoulders with no knees, fetlocks, or hooves.
The hind legs are partially fused together and into the ground/grass, lacking clear separation and joint definition.
The tail is not attached to the horse's body; it appears as a floating, blurry object in the background.
The lower legs transition abruptly into white 'socks' that fade out without ending in hooves, violating biological reality.
